beskerm_bedenkings.woord: hoofsaaklik in die laer, warm dele
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'laer' on its own can be read as 'lower on the map' (further south) rather than low-lying; 'laagliggende' would be unambiguous, but the wording is protected, so a person should decide whether the ambiguity matters for a Grade 5 reader.
